selected_evidence.summary: Shows the exact cron expression, active/enabled crond, correct file metadata, successful output appends, and persistence after reboot.

Captures healthy pre-reboot state and restart acknowledgement, proves the boot ID changed from a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45 to f21ec34e-eacc-4902-85ff-f45e408aa187, and verifies recovered service, schedule, and retained log data.

commands.stdout:
#!/bin/sh
printf 'inventory maintenance completed at %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
crond_unit=ActiveState=active
SubState=running
UnitFileState=enabled

commands.command: tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance.XXXXXX) && printf '%s\n' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin' '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' > "$tmpfile" && chown root:root "$tmpfile" && chmod 0644 "$tmpfile" && mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance && restorecon /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true; test -f /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
commands.stderr: mktemp: failed to create file via template ‘/etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance.XXXXXX’: Permission denied

commands.command: tmpfile=$(mktemp /tmp/inventory-maintenance-cron.XXXXXX) && printf '%s\n' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin' '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' > "$tmpfile" && sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$tmpfile" /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance; rc=$?; rm -f "$tmpfile"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then sudo -n restorecon /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit "$rc"
